strings.text: An old water tower; its shadow lies across the sleepers.
strings.translation: Uma velha caixa-d’água; a sombra dela se estende sobre os dormentes.

strings.text: The traveller has got there and stands by the water tower.
strings.translation: O viajante chegou e está parado junto à caixa-d’água.

strings.text: The traveller has got there and stands by the station building, next to the lamp.
strings.translation: O viajante chegou e está parado junto ao prédio da estação, ao lado do poste.

strings.text: The traveller has got there and stands by the old shed.
strings.translation: O viajante chegou e está parado junto ao velho galpão.

strings.text: The rusty hatch door at the foot of the tower gave with a creak and opened; it is dark inside and smells of old water.
strings.translation: A portinhola enferrujada na base da torre cedeu com um rangido e se abriu; dentro está escuro e cheira a água velha.

strings.text: The hatch door is wide open.
The hatch door slammed shut with a dull iron clang.
strings.translation: A portinhola bateu com um baque surdo de ferro.

strings.text: The tumbleweed rolled up to the tower and got stuck in the grass by the concrete base.
strings.translation: O amaranto-bravo rolou até a torre e ficou preso no mato junto à base de concreto.

strings.text: The wind tore the tumbleweed away from the tower and rolled it off into the steppe.
strings.translation: O vento arrancou o amaranto-bravo da torre e o levou rolando para a estepe.

strings.text: The chain has started swinging and clinks against the rusty ladder.
strings.translation: A corrente começou a balançar e tilinta contra a escada enferrujada.

strings.text: The lamp by the station has gone out.
strings.translation: O poste junto à estação se apagou.

strings.text: The lamp by the station has flickered back to life.
strings.translation: O poste junto à estação voltou a acender, piscando.
